system.description:
ARCHER ATTACK FLOURISH RANGER ZEN ARCHER

Prerequisites Dex 1, Wis 1, BAB +8

Action 2 AP

Make a ranged Strike which counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. You gain advantage on the attack.

Automated: press Use (2 AP): a ranged Strike with advantage, which counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty. Open to the Archer archetype and the Ranger now, and to the Zen Archer when Block 7 adds it (Graham's B6-10). The prerequisites are written as the system reads them ("Dex +1, Wis +1").
system.traits: Archer, Attack, Flourish, Ranger, Zen Archer
